country_filter.all_behavior: Show all imported candidates from every represented country in one combined list; keep country attribution on every record.
country_filter.country_behavior: Filter the same catalogue by exact ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
country_filter.unknown_country_behavior: Keep the candidate under ZZ with a neutral globe icon; never infer country from language or channel name.

youtube_live_discovery.playback_policy: Use the official YouTube watch URL/player only; never extract or rehost the media stream.
youtube_live_discovery.coverage_note: Search results are query-, quota-, language-, and region-dependent, not a complete inventory of all live YouTube channels.

official_web_channels.source: Official broadcaster websites and authorized embeds
official_web_channels.playback_policy: Use official embeddable player when allowed; otherwise open the broadcaster website.
official_web_channels.limitation: There is no universal index of every global broadcaster website.

movie_and_series_discovery.purpose: Titles, descriptions, posters, seasons, episode metadata, and region-specific watch-provider discovery where offered.
movie_and_series_discovery.playback_policy: Metadata is not a video stream and does not grant playback or redistribution rights.
movie_and_series_discovery.attribution: Display provider attribution and comply with current TMDB terms. Recheck licensing before commercial use.

public_collection_media.admission: Check item-level rights and permitted playback before showing an item as free/legal to watch.

reliability.grade_A: Official broadcaster or authorized CDN; repeated successful tests across times and network locations.
reliability.grade_B: Known broadcaster-origin source; repeated tests, but limited coverage.
reliability.grade_C: Community stream with insufficient or intermittent checks; hidden from default catalogue.

update_policy.stream_health_checks: scheduled and rate-limited; never run from every client device
update_policy.stale_stream_action: hide from default approved catalogue pending recheck

important: This is a discovery/import contract. Imported records are candidates, not automatically free, authorized, stable, or approved.

implementation.refresh: Daily at 04:23 UTC and manual workflow dispatch
implementation.safety: Generated records remain candidate/not_reviewed and are never directly playable until reviewed.

UNKNOWN.label: Auto / unknown
UNKNOWN.note: Do not claim a resolution until measured during playback.

quality_selection: Auto by default; allow manual selection only among variants actually supplied by the stream. Never upscale and label as native 4K.

online_playlist_sources.behavior: The user selects one source in the IPTV Sources screen; the app downloads it over HTTPS, parses HTTPS channel stream URLs, and saves or refreshes that package in a separate imported-channel library. Source selection never starts playback and never replaces the user playlist. Imported packages are played only from the Live Broadcast screen. The source list is fetched again on next selection; no client background polling is required.

limits.redirect_policy: HTTPS only; redirect host must match the source's exact allowlisted host.

sources.attribution: Doubo Public Channel Directory, CC BY 4.0 link-selection data

sources.coverage: smaller quality-focused free-TV list; may be geo-restricted

online_playlist_sources.safety: Sources are discovery/playback entry points, not proof of blanket redistribution rights. The app never downloads video content itself, never follows cross-host or non-HTTPS redirects, rejects insecure/credential-bearing stream URLs and preserves provider attribution. Paid/DRM/conditional-access streams must not be bypassed.

official_broadcaster_web_destinations: Al Jazeera Arabic and English, CGTN, Euronews, and NASA+ are presented as external official playback pages; they are not extracted into private media URLs.

adult_content_policy.classification: Only explicit age labels (TV-MA, NC-17, R18, 18+) and clear adult category labels are classified. Generic Movies/Series labels are not adult classifications.
adult_content_policy.ordinary_catalogue: Adult-classified stream URLs are excluded from normal live, search, favourites and recent-channel surfaces, including when duplicate source metadata conflicts.
adult_content_policy.playback: Blocked until a source has passed separate rights review.
adult_content_policy.source_policy: Do not add public, anonymous, pirated, subscription-only, DRM-protected or unclear-rights sources. A free URL is not proof of permission to stream or redistribute.
adult_content_policy.access: PIN-gated local section; salted PBKDF2 verifier, temporary lockout after repeated failures, optional hidden navigation entry.
adult_content_policy.private_package_storage: Downloaded separately from the ordinary IPTV source library. These are broad movies/series discovery lists, not adult packages; only explicitly age-rated or explicit-labeled entries may be shown in the PIN-protected private section. Unclassified entries remain isolated.

official_mature_service.integration: External official information link only; no M3U extraction or in-app playback.
official_mature_service.device_note: Provider states TCL Smart TV preloading is available and Android TV support is coming soon; availability can vary.
